configuration.correctness_validation: after every measured and warmup operation where output can be checked
configuration.scope: Sequential in-memory operations; no disk I/O, password KDF timing, network, or process startup.
configuration.order: Fixed mode/payload order; shared keys and decapsulation ciphertext reused per case; fresh encapsulation/nonce on encryption.
configuration.limitations: Single local run; noisy machine-dependent timings; modes do not have equivalent security claims; signing always ML-DSA-65.
